out.title: Independent Director Gautam Doshi resigns; NCD issuance approved
out.summary: Gautam Doshi resigned as Non-Executive Independent Director effective 12 October 2026, citing personal reasons; Board also approved NCD issuance up to INR 10,000 crore via private placement.

person.name: Gautam Doshi
person.bio: Independent Director of Sun Pharmaceutical Industries; also ceased committee memberships upon resignation. No further background provided in the filing.
